리뷰 거절: web/src/lib/markdown-import.ts:299-306 (with :250 and :254) Once a banner is seen, EVERY line from that point to EOF is cut by the exporter's rules, including a plain (non-umm) Markdown file that the import screen appended after the export. ImportThoughtsModal.tsx:65 joins `[current text, ...picked file contents]` with `

---

`, so picking an export and an ordinary notes file in one go puts the plain file after the export about half the time. Reproduced against this branch: export (`# 공간` / banner / `## 첫 생각` / `본문` / `- id: \`aaaa\`` / `- canvas: \`10, 20\``) + `

---

` + a plain file of `# 노트 A|B|C` yields ONE thought whose content is "본문

- id: `aaaa`
- canvas: `10, 20`


---

# 노트 A

가

# 노트 B

나

# 노트 C

다" with sourceId/x/y all lost. On main the same input yields 4 correct thoughts and the export thought keeps id `aaaa` and canvas 10,20. This is a data-losing regression that resurrects the exact defect the file's own header comment (markdown-import.ts:72-76) says the feature exists to prevent: metadata carried into the body, ids dropped, three notes collapsed into one wall of text. / web/src/lib/markdown-import.test.ts:412-441 The new tests do not cover this case. 'still tells two exports apart' only exercises export+export (both halves carry a banner, so the second `# ` is found). No test joins an export with non-export Markdown, which is the case the change breaks — so the suite passes while the regression is live.
